name: fastar

about.summary: High-level bindings for the Rust tar crate
High-level bindings for the Rust tar crate

raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.12.0"
  cov_fail_linux: "83"

package:
  name: fastar
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/f/fastar/fastar-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: bba71522eae6a7627a5514ffdd4ac9645ef27d82e23931d79fd974bb49c3f2ad

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    env:
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: fat
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
      CARGO: cargo-auditable-wrapper${{ ".bat" if win }}
      ZSTD_SYS_USE_PKG_CONFIG: "1"
    content:
      - if: win
        then:
          - copy "%RECIPE_DIR%\cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat" "%BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\bin\cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat"
        else:
          - cp "${RECIPE_DIR}/cargo-auditable-wrapper.sh" "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper"
          - chmod 755 "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper"
      - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check
      - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("rust") }}
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
    - cargo-auditable
    - pkg-config
  host:
    - maturin >=1.14.1,<2.0
    - pip
    - python
    - zstd
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports: fastar
      pip_check: true
  - files:
      source:
        - tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - backports.zstd
        - mypy
        - psutil
        - pytest-codspeed
        - pytest-cov
    script:
      env:
        # upstream tests on linux; most of the below are due to OS-level
        # differences in error message strings
        PYTEST_ADDOPTS: |-
          ${{
            '-k "not unpack_raises_if_file_would_overwrite_existing_directory"'
            if osx
          }}${{
            ('-k "not (' ~ ( [
              'append_preserves_directory_permissions',
              'append_preserves_file_permissions',
              'close_closes_archive',
              'context_manager_closes_archive',
              'open_raises_if_file_does_not_exist',
              'open_raises_if_insufficient_permissions',
              'open_raises_if_no_permissions',
              'open_raises_if_path_is_directory',
              'unpack_keeps_contents_of_conflicting_directories',
              'unpack_overwrites_permissions_of_conflicting_directories',
              'unpack_overwrites_permissions_of_conflicting_files',
              'unpack_preserves_directory_permissions',
              'unpack_preserves_file_permissions',
              'unpack_raises_if_file_would_overwrite_existing_directory',
            ] | join(' or ') ) ~ ')"')
            if win
          }}
      content:
        - coverage run --source=fastar --branch -m pytest -vv --tb=long --color=yes
        - coverage report --show-missing --skip-covered ${{ '--fail-under ' ~ cov_fail_linux if linux }}
        - mypy -p fastar

about:
  summary: High-level bindings for the Rust tar crate
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/fastar
  repository: https://github.com/DoctorJohn/fastar

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - bollwyvl
